Kenneth Grahame, The Wind in the Willows.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/kenneth-grahame/the-wind-in-the-willows

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Kenneth Grahame, the author, died 1932 (Wikidata Q314897, P570 = 1932-07-06).

First publication of the text used: 1908. SE colophon: 'The Wind in the Willows was published in 1908 by Kenneth Grahame.'

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1908, before 1931, and the edition's rights statement (quoted below) places it in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin (not stated in the facts; the possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa): each has a copyright term of life plus 70 years or less. The last person to die died in 1932, so the work is in the public domain in each of them no later than 1 January 2003.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
